memberships.page_title: The Minimum Dimension for a Cubic-Homogeneous Counterexample

statement: Prove the extension statement E(N): no sl_r or sp_r prolongation extension of total dimension at most N satisfies the Engel, irreducibility, collision, and minimal-monolith conditions; E(16) gives a lower bound 17 and E(18) gives 19.
title: Exclude Low-Dimensional sl and sp Prolongation Extensions
